title: "BAMModels"
format: docx
editor: visual
---

## BAM fitting to estimate dZ-Z curves for different management

to evaluate the current geomorphic changes at the different management sites, we made the Z-ΔZ plots comparing the 2016 (2018 for dunes) data to the 2022 data. We computed the elevation change (ΔZ) pixelwise per mapped polygon and grouped them per management method. The Z-ΔZ curve was fitted to the data by using a generalized additive model for very large datasets (Bam function from the mcvg-package). The model is fitted using the “scat”-family (student-t distribution), which is often used for heavily tailed response variables (such as elevation data). After the fitting, we average the model over the polygons to obtain a population-level smooth per management. The model now represent a mean trend for both managements and can show averaged geomorphic changes.

## Dunes

```{r}
#| echo: false
# ============================================================
# Libraries
# ============================================================
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)
library(patchwork)
library(matrixStats)

# ============================================================
# 1. Load polygons
# ============================================================
poly_nbs  <- vect("C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Single_NBS/Notches_all.shp")
poly_conv <- vect("C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Single_NBS/Control_notches_all.shp")

poly_nbs$Management  <- "NBS"
poly_conv$Management <- "Conventional"

poly_nbs$ID  <- seq_len(nrow(poly_nbs))
poly_conv$ID <- seq_len(nrow(poly_conv)) + nrow(poly_nbs)

polys <- rbind(poly_nbs, poly_conv)

# ============================================================
# 2. Load DEMs
# ============================================================
dem_paths <- list(
  "2010" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2010.tif",
  "2011" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2011.tif",
  "2012" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2012.tif",
  "2013" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2013.tif",
  "2014" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2014.tif",
  "2015" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2015.tif",
  "2016" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2016.tif",
  "2017" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2017.tif",
  "2018" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2018.tif",
  "2019" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2019.tif",
  "2020" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2020.tif",
  "2021" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2021.tif",
  "2022" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2022.tif"
)

dems <- map(dem_paths, rast)

# ============================================================
# 3. Extract pixel values
# ============================================================
extract_list <- map(names(dems), function(year) {
  dem    <- dems[[year]]
  vals   <- terra::extract(dem, polys)
  valcol <- setdiff(colnames(vals), "ID")
  vals   <- vals %>% rename(elev = all_of(valcol))
  vals$year <- year
  vals
})

dat <- bind_rows(extract_list) %>%
  left_join(polys |> as.data.frame() |> select(ID, Management), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev))

# ============================================================
# 4. Pixel-wise OLS slope (2016-2022), z = 2016 elevation
# ============================================================
years_use <- 2016:2022

wide_df <- dat %>%
  filter(year %in% as.character(years_use)) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Management, year_num) %>%
  mutate(pixel_idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(ID, Management, pixel_idx),
    names_from  = year_num,
    values_from = elev
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

elev_mat <- wide_df %>%
  select(all_of(as.character(years_use))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

x          <- years_use - mean(years_use)
ss_x       <- sum(x^2)
ols_slopes <- (elev_mat - rowMeans(elev_mat)) %*% x / ss_x

pixel_data <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(
    dz = as.numeric(ols_slopes),
    z  = as.numeric(`2016`)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Management, dz, z) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dz), !is.na(z)) %>%
  mutate(ID = factor(ID), Management = factor(Management))  # ID factor added
# Note: ID kept for normalisation grouping, not used in model

# Min-max normalise z within each polygon
# (preserves relative elevation structure while making polygons comparable)
pixel_data <- pixel_data %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(z = (z - min(z, na.rm = TRUE)) /
               (max(z, na.rm = TRUE) - min(z, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# 4b renaming
# ============================================================
pixel_sub <- pixel_data

# ============================================================
# 5. CDF difference of normalised 2016 elevation by Management
# ============================================================
pixel_NBS  <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(z)
pixel_Conv <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(z)

cdf_NBS  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS)
cdf_Conv <- ecdf(pixel_Conv)

z_seq    <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)   # z is now [0,1] after normalisation
cdf_diff <- cdf_NBS(z_seq) - cdf_Conv(z_seq)
cumulative_deficit <- cumsum(cdf_diff * mean(diff(z_seq)))

cdf_df <- data.frame(
  z                  = z_seq,
  CDF_diff           = cdf_diff,
  cumulative_deficit = cumulative_deficit
)

max_deficit_m <- abs(cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)])

top_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = CDF_diff)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CDF_diff, ymax = 0),
              fill = "red", alpha = 0.3,
              data = subset(cdf_df, CDF_diff < 0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(title = "CDF Difference (NBS - Conventional)",
       x = NULL, y = "CDF Difference") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

bottom_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = cumulative_deficit)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text",
           x     = 0.02,
           y     = cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)],
           label = paste0("Mean elevation deficit = ", round(max_deficit_m, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Elevation Deficit",
       x = "Normalised elevation z (2016)", y = "Cumulative Deficit") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(top_plot / bottom_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)))

# ============================================================
# 6. BAM: separate smooths per management via by=
# ============================================================

# Main model — by= gives each management type its own smooth
# + Management provides the intercepts for each level
bam_dunes <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z, by = Management) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# Null model: shared smooth, management intercept only
m_null_dunes <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(bam_dunes)

# ── gratia: model appraisal ───────────────────────────────────

# 1. Draw smooths with residuals overlaid
draw(bam_dunes, residuals = TRUE) &
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# 2. Residual diagnostics — simulation-based QQ for scat()
appraise(bam_dunes, method = "simulate")

# 3. Concurvity check
concrvity(bam_dunes)

# 4. Smooth estimates with simultaneous confidence intervals
sm <- smooth_estimates(bam_dunes) |> add_confint()
draw(sm)

# 5. Derivatives — where along normalised z is dz changing significantly?
deriv_Conv <- derivatives(
  bam_dunes,
  term = "s(z):ManagementConventional",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "Conventional")
)
deriv_NBS <- derivatives(
  bam_dunes,
  term = "s(z):ManagementNBS",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "NBS")
)

draw(deriv_Conv) + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - Conventional")
draw(deriv_NBS)  + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - NBS")

# 6. LRT model comparison
anova(m_null_dunes, bam_dunes, test = "Chisq")

# 7. Fallback QQ if appraise() spike reappears
qq.gam(bam_dunes, rep = 100, method = "simulate")

# ============================================================
# 7. Prediction grid — averaged over polygon random effects
# ============================================================
z_seq_pred <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  z          = z_seq_pred,
  Management = levels(pixel_sub$Management),
  ID         = levels(pixel_sub$ID)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Management = factor(Management, levels = levels(pixel_sub$Management)),
    ID         = factor(ID,         levels = levels(pixel_sub$ID))
  )

pred <- predict(bam_dunes, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
pred_grid$fit <- pred$fit
pred_grid$se  <- pred$se.fit

pred_avg <- pred_grid %>%
  group_by(Management, z) %>%
  summarise(
    fit = mean(fit),
    se  = sqrt(mean(se^2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    upper = fit + 2 * se,
    lower = fit - 2 * se
  )
# ============================================================
# 8. Residuals
# ============================================================
pixel_sub$resid <- residuals(bam_dunes)

pixel_var_resid <- pixel_sub %>%
  group_by(Management) %>%
  summarise(
    var_resid = var(resid),
    sd_resid  = sd(resid),
    n         = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
print(pixel_var_resid)

fligner.test(resid ~ Management, data = pixel_sub)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(fitted(bam_dunes), abs(resid))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(z, abs(resid), color = Management)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#03A9FF", "Conventional" = "#FFBB03")) +
  labs(x = "Normalised elevation z (2016)", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ============================================================
# 9. ECDF of 2022 elevation with crossing points
# Note: 2022 elevation kept in raw metres (not normalised)
# ============================================================
elev_2022 <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(elev_2022 = as.numeric(`2022`)) %>%
  select(ID, Management, elev_2022) %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev_2022)) %>%
  mutate(Management = factor(Management))

pixel_NBS_2022  <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(elev_2022)
pixel_Conv_2022 <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(elev_2022)

cdf_NBS_2022  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS_2022)
cdf_Conv_2022 <- ecdf(pixel_Conv_2022)

z_vals    <- seq(min(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                 max(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                 length.out = 1000)
diff_cdf  <- cdf_NBS_2022(z_vals) - cdf_Conv_2022(z_vals)
cross_idx <- which(diff_cdf[-1] * diff_cdf[-length(diff_cdf)] < 0)

cross_points <- sapply(cross_idx, function(i) {
  x1 <- z_vals[i];   x2 <- z_vals[i + 1]
  y1 <- diff_cdf[i]; y2 <- diff_cdf[i + 1]
  x1 - y1 * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
})

cross_table <- data.frame(
  z_cross   = cross_points,
  cdf_value = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)
)
print(cross_table)

ecdf_plot_2022 <- ggplot(elev_2022, aes(x = elev_2022, color = Management)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#03A9FF", "Conventional" = "#FFBB03")) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)),
    aes(x = z, y = y), color = "red", size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "yellow",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points),
                      label = round(cross_points, 2)),
    aes(x = z, y = y, label = label),
    vjust = -1, color = "red", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "ECDF of Pixel Elevation z (2022) by Management",
       x = "Elevation z (2022) [m]", y = "Cumulative proportion",
       color = "Management") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(ecdf_plot_2022)

# ============================================================
# 10. Bin comparison table — bins on normalised z [0,1]
# ============================================================
bin_compare_table <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(z_bin = floor(z / 0.1) * 0.1) %>%   # 0.1 bins on [0,1] scale
  group_by(Management, z_bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_dz = mean(fit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = mean_dz) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_NBS_minus_Conv = NBS - Conventional,
    Advantage = case_when(
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv > 0 ~ "NBS higher accretion",
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv < 0 ~ "Conventional higher accretion",
      TRUE                    ~ "Equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(z_bin)
print(bin_compare_table)

# ============================================================
# 11. Trapezoidal integration
# ============================================================
curve_wide <- pred_avg %>%
  select(z, Management, fit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = fit) %>%
  arrange(z)

z_step <- diff(curve_wide$z)

I_NBS  <- sum((curve_wide$NBS[-1]          + curve_wide$NBS[-nrow(curve_wide)])          / 2 * z_step)
I_Conv <- sum((curve_wide$Conventional[-1] + curve_wide$Conventional[-nrow(curve_wide)]) / 2 * z_step)
z_range <- diff(range(curve_wide$z))   # = 1 after normalisation

integral_table <- data.frame(
  Management          = c("NBS", "Conventional"),
  Integral            = round(c(I_NBS, I_Conv), 4),
  Normalized_integral = round(c(I_NBS / z_range, I_Conv / z_range), 4)
)
print(integral_table)

diff_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Integral difference (NBS - Conv)", "Normalized difference (NBS - Conv)",
             "Integral ratio (NBS / Conv)",      "Normalized ratio (NBS / Conv)"),
  Value  = round(c(I_NBS - I_Conv,
                   I_NBS / z_range - I_Conv / z_range,
                   I_NBS / I_Conv,
                   (I_NBS / z_range) / (I_Conv / z_range)), 4)
)
print(diff_table)

# ============================================================
# 12. Final combined plot — x-axis now normalised [0,1]
# ============================================================
bin_width <- 0.1         # bins on normalised scale
xmin      <- 0
xmax      <- 1
slr_m     <- 2.9 / 1000
colors    <- c("Dunes" = "#FFBB03", "NBS" = "#03A9FF")

pred_avg_plot <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Dunes"))

pixel_sub_plot <- pixel_sub %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Dunes")) %>%
  mutate(
    z_bin      = floor(z / bin_width) * bin_width,
    bin_center = z_bin + bin_width / 2,
    bin_factor = factor(bin_center)
  )

x_ticks <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 0.1)

x_grid_theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
  panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
)

# ── Top panel: BAM curves ─────────────────────────────────────
bam_curve_plot <- ggplot(pred_avg_plot,
                         aes(x = z, y = fit, color = Management, fill = Management)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,     linewidth = 0.9, colour = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = slr_m, linewidth = 0.9, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = xmax, y = slr_m,
           label = "Current SLR = 2.9 mm yr\u207b\u00b9",
           colour = "red", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.6, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.05, 0.22), xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(y = expression(Delta * "Z (m yr"^-1 * ")"), x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
    plot.margin        = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Middle panel: residual boxplots ───────────────────────────
resid_boxplot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                        aes(x = bin_center, y = resid,
                            group = interaction(bin_factor, Management),
                            fill  = Management)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(
    position      = position_dodge(width = bin_width * 0.9),
    width         = bin_width * 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha         = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Residuals (m/year)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Bottom panel: density ─────────────────────────────────────
pdf_plot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                   aes(x = z, fill = Management, colour = Management)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Normalised elevation z (2016) [0-1]", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined_plot <- bam_curve_plot /
                 resid_boxplot  /
                 pdf_plot +
                 plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 0.8))

combined_plot

# ============================================================
# 12b. Density-weighted mean dz per management
# ============================================================

dens_NBS  <- density(pixel_sub_plot %>% filter(Management == "NBS")   %>% pull(z),
                     from = 0, to = 1, n = 1000)
dens_Conv <- density(pixel_sub_plot %>% filter(Management == "Dunes") %>% pull(z),
                     from = 0, to = 1, n = 1000)

dz_NBS  <- pred_avg_plot %>% filter(Management == "NBS")   %>% arrange(z) %>% pull(fit)
dz_Conv <- pred_avg_plot %>% filter(Management == "Dunes") %>% arrange(z) %>% pull(fit)

w_NBS  <- dens_NBS$y  / sum(dens_NBS$y)
w_Conv <- dens_Conv$y / sum(dens_Conv$y)

mean_dz_NBS  <- sum(dz_NBS  * w_NBS)  * 1000   # now mm/yr
mean_dz_Conv <- sum(dz_Conv * w_Conv) * 1000   # now mm/yr

weighted_mean_table <- data.frame(
  Management         = c("NBS", "Conventional"),
  Mean_dz_mm_yr      = round(c(mean_dz_NBS, mean_dz_Conv), 2),
  Mean_dz_unweighted = round(c(mean(dz_NBS * 1000), mean(dz_Conv * 1000)), 2),
  SLR_mm_yr          = 2.9,
  Surplus_vs_SLR     = round(c(mean_dz_NBS, mean_dz_Conv) - 2.9, 2)
)
print(weighted_mean_table)

cat("\n=== Density-weighted mean accretion rates ===\n")
cat("Conventional:", round(mean_dz_Conv, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("NBS:         ", round(mean_dz_NBS,  2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("SLR:          2.9 mm/yr\n")
cat("---------------------------------------------\n")
cat("NBS surplus vs SLR:  ", round(mean_dz_NBS  - 2.9, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("Conv surplus vs SLR: ", round(mean_dz_Conv - 2.9, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("Difference (NBS - Conv):", round(mean_dz_NBS - mean_dz_Conv, 2), "mm/yr\n")
```

## Overwash

```{R}
#| echo: false
# ============================================================
# Libraries
# ============================================================
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)
library(patchwork)
library(matrixStats)

# ============================================================
# 1. Load polygons
# ============================================================
poly_nbs  <- vect("C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Single_NBS/Nature_overwashes_activeZ.shp")
poly_conv <- vect("C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Single_NBS/Stuifdijk_overwashes_activeZ.shp")

poly_nbs$Management  <- "NBS"
poly_conv$Management <- "Conventional"

poly_nbs$ID  <- seq_len(nrow(poly_nbs))
poly_conv$ID <- seq_len(nrow(poly_conv)) + nrow(poly_nbs)

polys <- rbind(poly_nbs, poly_conv)

# ============================================================
# 2. Load DEMs
# ============================================================
dem_paths <- list(
  "2010" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2010.tif",
  "2011" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2011.tif",
  "2012" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2012.tif",
  "2013" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2013.tif",
  "2014" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2014.tif",
  "2015" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2015.tif",
  "2016" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2016.tif",
  "2017" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2017.tif",
  "2018" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2018.tif",
  "2019" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2019.tif",
  "2020" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2020.tif",
  "2021" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2021.tif",
  "2022" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2022.tif"
)

dems <- map(dem_paths, rast)

# ============================================================
# 3. Extract pixel values
# ============================================================
extract_list <- map(names(dems), function(year) {
  dem    <- dems[[year]]
  vals   <- terra::extract(dem, polys)
  valcol <- setdiff(colnames(vals), "ID")
  vals   <- vals %>% rename(elev = all_of(valcol))
  vals$year <- year
  vals
})

dat <- bind_rows(extract_list) %>%
  left_join(polys |> as.data.frame() |> select(ID, Management), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev))

# ============================================================
# 4. Pixel-wise OLS slope (2016-2022), z = 2016 elevation
# ============================================================
years_use <- 2016:2022

wide_df <- dat %>%
  filter(year %in% as.character(years_use)) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Management, year_num) %>%
  mutate(pixel_idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(ID, Management, pixel_idx),
    names_from  = year_num,
    values_from = elev
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

elev_mat <- wide_df %>%
  select(all_of(as.character(years_use))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

x        <- years_use - mean(years_use)
ss_x     <- sum(x^2)
ols_slopes <- (elev_mat - rowMeans(elev_mat)) %*% x / ss_x

pixel_data <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(
    dz = as.numeric(ols_slopes),
    z  = as.numeric(`2016`)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Management, dz, z) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dz), !is.na(z)) %>%
  mutate(ID = factor(ID), Management = factor(Management))  

# ============================================================
# 4b. 
# ============================================================
pixel_sub <- pixel_data

# ============================================================
# 5. CDF difference of 2016 elevation (z) by Management
# ============================================================
pixel_NBS  <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(z)
pixel_Conv <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(z)

cdf_NBS  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS)
cdf_Conv <- ecdf(pixel_Conv)

z_seq    <- seq(min(pixel_sub$z), max(pixel_sub$z), length.out = 1000)
cdf_diff <- cdf_NBS(z_seq) - cdf_Conv(z_seq)
cumulative_deficit <- cumsum(cdf_diff * mean(diff(z_seq)))

cdf_df <- data.frame(
  z                  = z_seq,
  CDF_diff           = cdf_diff,
  cumulative_deficit = cumulative_deficit
)

max_deficit_m <- cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)]




top_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = CDF_diff)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CDF_diff, ymax = 0),
              fill = "red", alpha = 0.3,
              data = subset(cdf_df, CDF_diff < 0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(title = "CDF Difference (NBS - Conventional)", x = NULL, y = "CDF Difference") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

bottom_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = cumulative_deficit)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(cdf_df$z) + 0.2,
           y     = cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)],
           label = paste0("Mean elevation difference (NBS - Conv) = ", round(max_deficit_m, 3), " m"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Elevation Deficit",
       x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Cumulative Deficit (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(top_plot / bottom_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)))

# ============================================================
# 6. BAM: separate smooths per management via by=
# ============================================================

# Main model
bam_overwash <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z, by = Management) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# Null model: shared smooth, management intercept only
m_null_overwash <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(bam_overwash)

# ── gratia: model appraisal ───────────────────────────────────

# 1. Smooth terms with residuals overlaid
draw(bam_overwash, residuals = TRUE) &
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# 2. Residual diagnostics — simulation-based QQ more reliable for scat()
appraise(bam_overwash, method = "simulate")

# 3. Concurvity check
concrvity(bam_overwash)

# 4. Smooth estimates with simultaneous confidence intervals
sm <- smooth_estimates(bam_overwash) |> add_confint()
draw(sm)

# 5. Derivatives — where along z is accretion rate significantly changing?
deriv_Conv <- derivatives(
  bam_overwash,
  term = "s(z):ManagementConventional",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "Conventional")
)
deriv_NBS <- derivatives(
  bam_overwash,
  term = "s(z):ManagementNBS",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "NBS")
)

draw(deriv_Conv) + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - Conventional")
draw(deriv_NBS)  + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - NBS")

# 6. Model comparison LRT
anova(m_null_overwash, bam_overwash, test = "Chisq")

# 7. Fallback QQ if appraise() spike reappears
qq.gam(bam_overwash, rep = 100, method = "simulate")

# ============================================================
# 7. Prediction grid — averaged over polygon random effects
# ============================================================
z_seq_pred <- seq(min(pixel_sub$z), max(pixel_sub$z), length.out = 1000)

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  z          = z_seq_pred,
  Management = levels(pixel_sub$Management),
  ID         = levels(pixel_sub$ID)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Management = factor(Management, levels = levels(pixel_sub$Management)),
    ID         = factor(ID,         levels = levels(pixel_sub$ID))
  )

pred <- predict(bam_overwash, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
pred_grid$fit <- pred$fit
pred_grid$se  <- pred$se.fit

pred_avg <- pred_grid %>%
  group_by(Management, z) %>%
  summarise(
    fit = mean(fit),
    se  = sqrt(mean(se^2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    upper = fit + 2 * se,
    lower = fit - 2 * se
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. Residuals
# ============================================================
pixel_sub$resid <- residuals(bam_overwash)

pixel_var_resid <- pixel_sub %>%
  group_by(Management) %>%
  summarise(
    var_resid = var(resid),
    sd_resid  = sd(resid),
    n         = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
print(pixel_var_resid)

fligner.test(resid ~ Management, data = pixel_sub)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(fitted(bam_overwash), abs(resid))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(z, abs(resid), color = Management)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#03A9FF", "Conventional" = "#FFBB03")) +
  labs(x = "Elevation z (2016)", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ============================================================
# 9. ECDF of 2022 elevation with crossing points
# ============================================================
elev_2022 <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(elev_2022 = as.numeric(`2022`)) %>%
  select(ID, Management, elev_2022) %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev_2022)) %>%
  mutate(Management = factor(Management))

pixel_NBS_2022  <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(elev_2022)
pixel_Conv_2022 <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(elev_2022)

cdf_NBS_2022  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS_2022)
cdf_Conv_2022 <- ecdf(pixel_Conv_2022)

z_vals   <- seq(min(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                max(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                length.out = 1000)
diff_cdf <- cdf_NBS_2022(z_vals) - cdf_Conv_2022(z_vals)
cross_idx <- which(diff_cdf[-1] * diff_cdf[-length(diff_cdf)] < 0)

cross_points <- sapply(cross_idx, function(i) {
  x1 <- z_vals[i];   x2 <- z_vals[i + 1]
  y1 <- diff_cdf[i]; y2 <- diff_cdf[i + 1]
  x1 - y1 * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
})

cross_table <- data.frame(
  z_cross   = cross_points,
  cdf_value = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)
)
print(cross_table)

ecdf_plot_2022 <- ggplot(elev_2022, aes(x = elev_2022, color = Management)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#03A9FF", "Conventional" = "#FFBB03")) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)),
    aes(x = z, y = y), color = "red", size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "yellow",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points),
                      label = round(cross_points, 2)),
    aes(x = z, y = y, label = label),
    vjust = -1, color = "red", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "ECDF of Pixel Elevation z (2022) by Management",
       x = "Elevation z (2022) [m]", y = "Cumulative proportion",
       color = "Management") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(ecdf_plot_2022)

# ============================================================
# 10. Bin comparison table
# ============================================================
bin_compare_table <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(z_bin = floor(z / 0.5) * 0.5) %>%
  group_by(Management, z_bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_dz = mean(fit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = mean_dz) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_NBS_minus_Conv = NBS - Conventional,
    Advantage = case_when(
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv > 0 ~ "NBS higher accretion",
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv < 0 ~ "Conventional higher accretion",
      TRUE                    ~ "Equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(z_bin)
print(bin_compare_table)

# ============================================================
# 11. Trapezoidal integration
# ============================================================
curve_wide <- pred_avg %>%
  select(z, Management, fit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = fit) %>%
  arrange(z)

z_step <- diff(curve_wide$z)

I_NBS  <- sum((curve_wide$NBS[-1]          + curve_wide$NBS[-nrow(curve_wide)])          / 2 * z_step)
I_Conv <- sum((curve_wide$Conventional[-1] + curve_wide$Conventional[-nrow(curve_wide)]) / 2 * z_step)
z_range <- diff(range(curve_wide$z))

integral_table <- data.frame(
  Management          = c("NBS", "Conventional"),
  Integral            = round(c(I_NBS, I_Conv), 4),
  Normalized_integral = round(c(I_NBS / z_range, I_Conv / z_range), 4)
)
print(integral_table)

diff_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Integral difference (NBS - Conv)", "Normalized difference (NBS - Conv)",
             "Integral ratio (NBS / Conv)",      "Normalized ratio (NBS / Conv)"),
  Value  = round(c(I_NBS - I_Conv,
                   I_NBS / z_range - I_Conv / z_range,
                   I_NBS / I_Conv,
                   (I_NBS / z_range) / (I_Conv / z_range)), 4)
)
print(diff_table)

# ============================================================
# 12. Final combined plot
# ============================================================
bin_width <- 2.5
xmin      <- -5
xmax      <- 20
slr_m     <- 2.9 / 1000
colors    <- c("Artificial Sand Drift Dike" = "#FFBB03", "NBS" = "#03A9FF")

pred_avg_plot <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Artificial Sand Drift Dike"))

pixel_sub_plot <- pixel_sub %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Artificial Sand Drift Dike")) %>%
  mutate(
    z_bin      = floor(z / bin_width) * bin_width,
    bin_center = z_bin + bin_width / 2,
    bin_factor = factor(bin_center)
  )

x_ticks <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 2.5)

x_grid_theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
  panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
)

# ── Top panel: BAM curves ─────────────────────────────────────
bam_curve_plot <- ggplot(pred_avg_plot,
                         aes(x = z, y = fit, color = Management, fill = Management)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,     linewidth = 0.9, colour = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = slr_m, linewidth = 0.9, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = xmax, y = slr_m,
           label = "Current SLR = 2.9 mm yr\u207b\u00b9",
           colour = "red", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.6, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.01, 0.02), xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(y = expression(Delta * "Z (m yr"^-1 * ")"), x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
    plot.margin        = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Middle panel: residual boxplots ───────────────────────────
resid_boxplot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                        aes(x = bin_center, y = resid,
                            group = interaction(bin_factor, Management),
                            fill  = Management)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(
    position      = position_dodge(width = bin_width * 0.9),
    width         = bin_width * 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha         = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Residuals (m/year)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Bottom panel: density ─────────────────────────────────────
pdf_plot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                   aes(x = z, fill = Management, colour = Management)) +
  geom_density(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    alpha     = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    position  = "identity"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Elevation z (2016) [m]", y = "Normalized density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined_plot <- bam_curve_plot /
                 resid_boxplot  /
                 pdf_plot +
                 plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 0.8))

combined_plot

# ============================================================
# 12b. Density-weighted mean dz per management
# ============================================================

dens_NBS  <- density(pixel_sub_plot %>% filter(Management == "NBS")   %>% pull(z),
                     from = 0, to = 10, n = 1000)
dens_Conv <- density(pixel_sub_plot %>% filter(Management == "Artificial Sand Drift Dike") %>% pull(z),
                     from = 0, to = 10, n = 1000)

dz_NBS  <- pred_avg_plot %>% filter(Management == "NBS")   %>% arrange(z) %>% pull(fit)
dz_Conv <- pred_avg_plot %>% filter(Management == "Artificial Sand Drift Dike") %>% arrange(z) %>% pull(fit)

w_NBS  <- dens_NBS$y  / sum(dens_NBS$y)
w_Conv <- dens_Conv$y / sum(dens_Conv$y)

mean_dz_NBS  <- sum(dz_NBS  * w_NBS)  * 1000   # now mm/yr
mean_dz_Conv <- sum(dz_Conv * w_Conv) * 1000   # now mm/yr

weighted_mean_table <- data.frame(
  Management         = c("NBS", "Artificial Sand Drift Dike"),
  Mean_dz_mm_yr      = round(c(mean_dz_NBS, mean_dz_Conv), 2),
  Mean_dz_unweighted = round(c(mean(dz_NBS * 1000), mean(dz_Conv * 1000)), 2),
  SLR_mm_yr          = 2.9,
  Surplus_vs_SLR     = round(c(mean_dz_NBS, mean_dz_Conv) - 2.9, 2)
)
print(weighted_mean_table)

cat("\n=== Density-weighted mean accretion rates ===\n")
cat("Artificial Sand Drift Dike:", round(mean_dz_Conv, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("NBS:         ", round(mean_dz_NBS,  2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("SLR:          2.9 mm/yr\n")
cat("---------------------------------------------\n")
cat("NBS surplus vs SLR:  ", round(mean_dz_NBS  - 2.9, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("Artificial Sand Drift Dike surplus vs SLR: ", round(mean_dz_Conv - 2.9, 2), "mm/yr\n")
cat("Difference (NBS - Conv):", round(mean_dz_NBS - mean_dz_Conv, 2), "mm/yr\n")

```

```{r}
  "2020" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2020.tif",
  "2021" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2021.tif",
  "2022" = "C:/Users/6679242/OneDrive - Universiteit Utrecht/Documents/WADWAD/Data/Geodata/Accretion_vs_SLR/Rasters/Topography_2022.tif"
)

dems <- map(dem_paths, rast)

# ============================================================
# 3. Extract pixel values
# ============================================================
extract_list <- map(names(dems), function(year) {
  dem    <- dems[[year]]
  vals   <- terra::extract(dem, polys)
  valcol <- setdiff(colnames(vals), "ID")
  vals   <- vals %>% rename(elev = all_of(valcol))
  vals$year <- year
  vals
})

dat <- bind_rows(extract_list) %>%
  left_join(polys |> as.data.frame() |> select(ID, Management), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev))

# ============================================================
# 4. Pixel-wise OLS slope (2016-2022), z = 2016 elevation
# ============================================================
years_use <- 2016:2022

wide_df <- dat %>%
  filter(year %in% as.character(years_use)) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Management, year_num) %>%
  mutate(pixel_idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(ID, Management, pixel_idx),
    names_from  = year_num,
    values_from = elev
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

elev_mat <- wide_df %>%
  select(all_of(as.character(years_use))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

x          <- years_use - mean(years_use)
ss_x       <- sum(x^2)
ols_slopes <- (elev_mat - rowMeans(elev_mat)) %*% x / ss_x

pixel_data <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(
    dz = as.numeric(ols_slopes),
    z  = as.numeric(`2016`)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Management, dz, z) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dz), !is.na(z)) %>%
  mutate(ID = factor(ID), Management = factor(Management))

# ============================================================
# 4b. Elevation filter + zero filter
# ============================================================
pixel_sub <- pixel_data %>%
  filter(z >= -0.5, z <= 3.5)

# ============================================================
# 5. CDF difference of 2016 elevation (z) by Management
# ============================================================
pixel_NBS  <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(z)
pixel_Conv <- pixel_sub %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(z)

cdf_NBS  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS)
cdf_Conv <- ecdf(pixel_Conv)

z_seq    <- seq(min(pixel_sub$z), max(pixel_sub$z), length.out = 1000)
cdf_diff <- cdf_NBS(z_seq) - cdf_Conv(z_seq)
cumulative_deficit <- cumsum(cdf_diff * mean(diff(z_seq)))

cdf_df <- data.frame(
  z                  = z_seq,
  CDF_diff           = cdf_diff,
  cumulative_deficit = cumulative_deficit
)

max_deficit_m <- abs(cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)])

top_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = CDF_diff)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CDF_diff, ymax = 0),
              fill = "red", alpha = 0.3,
              data = subset(cdf_df, CDF_diff < 0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(title = "CDF Difference (NBS - Conventional)",
       x = NULL, y = "CDF Difference") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

bottom_plot <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(x = z, y = cumulative_deficit)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(cdf_df$z) + 0.2,
           y     = cdf_df$cumulative_deficit[nrow(cdf_df)],
           label = paste0("Mean elevation deficit = ", round(max_deficit_m, 3), " m"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Elevation Deficit",
       x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Cumulative Deficit (m)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(top_plot / bottom_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)))

# ============================================================
# 6. BAM: by= smooth per management + polygon random intercept
# ============================================================

# Main model — by= for separate smooths, s(ID, re) for polygon intercepts
bam_marsh <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z, by = Management) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# Null model — shared smooth, same random effect structure
m_null_marsh <- bam(
  dz ~ s(z) + Management + s(ID, bs = "re"),
  data   = pixel_sub,
  method = "REML",
  family = scat()
)

# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(bam_marsh)

# ── gratia: model appraisal ───────────────────────────────────

# 1. Draw smooths with residuals overlaid
draw(bam_marsh, residuals = TRUE) &
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# 2. Residual diagnostics
appraise(bam_marsh, method = "simulate")

# 3. Concurvity check
concrvity(bam_marsh)

# 4. Smooth estimates with simultaneous confidence intervals
sm <- smooth_estimates(bam_marsh) |> add_confint()
draw(sm)

# 5. Derivatives — where along z is accretion rate significantly changing?
deriv_Conv <- derivatives(
  bam_marsh,
  term = "s(z):ManagementConventional",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "Conventional")
)
deriv_NBS <- derivatives(
  bam_marsh,
  term = "s(z):ManagementNBS",
  data = pixel_sub |> filter(Management == "NBS")
)

draw(deriv_Conv) + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - Conventional (Embanked)")
draw(deriv_NBS)  + labs(title = "Derivative of s(z) - NBS")

# 6. LRT model comparison
anova(m_null_marsh, bam_marsh, test = "Chisq")

# 7. Fallback QQ
qq.gam(bam_marsh, rep = 100, method = "simulate")

# ============================================================
# 7. Fitted BAM curves (averaged over polygon random effects)
# ============================================================
z_seq_pred <- seq(min(pixel_sub$z), max(pixel_sub$z), length.out = 1000)

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  z          = z_seq_pred,
  Management = levels(pixel_sub$Management),
  ID         = levels(pixel_sub$ID)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Management = factor(Management, levels = levels(pixel_sub$Management)),
    ID         = factor(ID,         levels = levels(pixel_sub$ID))
  )

pred <- predict(bam_marsh, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
pred_grid$fit <- pred$fit
pred_grid$se  <- pred$se.fit

pred_avg <- pred_grid %>%
  group_by(Management, z) %>%
  summarise(
    fit = mean(fit),
    se  = sqrt(mean(se^2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    upper = fit + 2 * se,
    lower = fit - 2 * se
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. Residuals
# ============================================================
pixel_sub$resid <- residuals(bam_marsh)

pixel_var_resid <- pixel_sub %>%
  group_by(Management) %>%
  summarise(
    var_resid = var(resid),
    sd_resid  = sd(resid),
    n         = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
print(pixel_var_resid)

fligner.test(resid ~ Management, data = pixel_sub)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(fitted(bam_marsh), abs(resid))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(pixel_sub, aes(z, abs(resid), color = Management)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + geom_smooth() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#99CC33", "Conventional" = "#39b54a")) +
  labs(x = "Elevation z (2016)", y = "Absolute residuals") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ============================================================
# 9. ECDF of 2022 elevation with crossing points
# ============================================================
elev_2022 <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(elev_2022 = as.numeric(`2022`)) %>%
  select(ID, Management, elev_2022) %>%
  filter(!is.na(elev_2022)) %>%
  mutate(Management = factor(Management))

pixel_NBS_2022  <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "NBS")          %>% pull(elev_2022)
pixel_Conv_2022 <- elev_2022 %>% filter(Management == "Conventional") %>% pull(elev_2022)

cdf_NBS_2022  <- ecdf(pixel_NBS_2022)
cdf_Conv_2022 <- ecdf(pixel_Conv_2022)

z_vals    <- seq(min(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                 max(c(pixel_NBS_2022, pixel_Conv_2022)),
                 length.out = 1000)
diff_cdf  <- cdf_NBS_2022(z_vals) - cdf_Conv_2022(z_vals)
cross_idx <- which(diff_cdf[-1] * diff_cdf[-length(diff_cdf)] < 0)

cross_points <- sapply(cross_idx, function(i) {
  x1 <- z_vals[i];   x2 <- z_vals[i + 1]
  y1 <- diff_cdf[i]; y2 <- diff_cdf[i + 1]
  x1 - y1 * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
})

cross_table <- data.frame(
  z_cross   = cross_points,
  cdf_value = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)
)
print(cross_table)

ecdf_plot_2022 <- ggplot(elev_2022, aes(x = elev_2022, color = Management)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NBS" = "#99CC33", "Conventional" = "#39b54a")) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points)),
    aes(x = z, y = y), color = "red", size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "yellow",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(z = cross_points, y = cdf_NBS_2022(cross_points),
                      label = round(cross_points, 2)),
    aes(x = z, y = y, label = label),
    vjust = -1, color = "red", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "ECDF of Pixel Elevation z (2022) by Management",
       x = "Elevation z (2022) [m]", y = "Cumulative proportion",
       color = "Management") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(ecdf_plot_2022)

# ============================================================
# 10. Bin comparison table
# ============================================================
bin_compare_table <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(z_bin = floor(z / 0.5) * 0.5) %>%
  group_by(Management, z_bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_dz = mean(fit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = mean_dz) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_NBS_minus_Conv = NBS - Conventional,
    Advantage = case_when(
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv > 0 ~ "NBS higher accretion",
      diff_NBS_minus_Conv < 0 ~ "Conventional higher accretion",
      TRUE                    ~ "Equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(z_bin)
print(bin_compare_table)

# ============================================================
# 11. Trapezoidal integration
# ============================================================
curve_wide <- pred_avg %>%
  select(z, Management, fit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Management, values_from = fit) %>%
  arrange(z)

z_step <- diff(curve_wide$z)

I_NBS  <- sum((curve_wide$NBS[-1]          + curve_wide$NBS[-nrow(curve_wide)])          / 2 * z_step)
I_Conv <- sum((curve_wide$Conventional[-1] + curve_wide$Conventional[-nrow(curve_wide)]) / 2 * z_step)
z_range <- diff(range(curve_wide$z))

integral_table <- data.frame(
  Management          = c("NBS", "Conventional"),
  Integral            = round(c(I_NBS, I_Conv), 4),
  Normalized_integral = round(c(I_NBS / z_range, I_Conv / z_range), 4)
)
print(integral_table)

diff_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Integral difference (NBS - Conv)", "Normalized difference (NBS - Conv)",
             "Integral ratio (NBS / Conv)",      "Normalized ratio (NBS / Conv)"),
  Value  = round(c(I_NBS - I_Conv,
                   I_NBS / z_range - I_Conv / z_range,
                   I_NBS / I_Conv,
                   (I_NBS / z_range) / (I_Conv / z_range)), 4)
)
print(diff_table)

# ============================================================
# 12. Final combined plot
# ============================================================
bin_width <- 0.5
xmin      <- -1.5
xmax      <- 3
slr_m     <- 2.9 / 1000
colors    <- c("Embanked" = "#39b54a", "NBS" = "#99CC33")

pred_avg_plot <- pred_avg %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Embanked"))

pixel_sub_plot <- pixel_sub %>%
  mutate(Management = recode(Management, "Conventional" = "Embanked")) %>%
  mutate(
    z_bin      = floor(z / bin_width) * bin_width,
    bin_center = z_bin + bin_width / 2,
    bin_factor = factor(bin_center)
  )

x_ticks <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 0.5)

x_grid_theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
  panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
)

# ── Top panel: BAM curves ─────────────────────────────────────
bam_curve_plot <- ggplot(pred_avg_plot,
                         aes(x = z, y = fit, color = Management, fill = Management)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,     linewidth = 0.9, colour = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = slr_m, linewidth = 0.9, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = xmax, y = slr_m,
           label = "Current SLR = 2.9 mm yr\u207b\u00b9",
           colour = "red", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.6, size = 4) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(z = c(1.16, 1.80), dz = c(0.0062, 0.0041)),
    aes(x = z, y = dz), colour = "#03A9FF", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(
      z     = c(1.16, 1.80),
      dz    = c(0.0062, 0.0041),
      label = c("Kroon's Polders (Wolters et al. 2005)",
                "Langeoog sommerpolder (Frölich 2015)")
    ),
    aes(x = z, y = dz, label = label),
    colour = "#03A9FF", hjust = -0.05, vjust = -0.6, size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(0.01, -0.03)) +
  labs(y = expression(Delta * "Z (m yr"^-1 * ")"), x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
    plot.margin        = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Middle panel: residual boxplots ───────────────────────────
resid_boxplot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                        aes(x = bin_center, y = resid,
                            group = interaction(bin_factor, Management),
                            fill  = Management)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(
    position      = position_dodge(width = bin_width * 0.9),
    width         = bin_width * 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha         = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Residuals (m/year)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 10, 5)
  )

# ── Bottom panel: density ─────────────────────────────────────
pdf_plot <- ggplot(pixel_sub_plot,
                   aes(x = z, fill = Management, colour = Management)) +
  geom_density(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    alpha     = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    position  = "identity"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Elevation z (2016) [m]", y = "Normalized density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  x_grid_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined_plot <- bam_curve_plot /
                 resid_boxplot  /
                 pdf_plot +
                 plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 0.8))

combined_plot

```
